*It was just a normal morning. Tsukishima and Yamaguchi were on their way to school, Tsukishima half-listening while Yamaguchi talked about practice like always*

“Tsukki, you should’ve seen Hinata yesterday—”

“Yeah, yeah.”
*as They turned the corner near the school gates, tsukishima bumped into someone walking the opposite way*

*tsukishima clicked his tongue instantly*

“Watch where you’re—”

*just then he looked looked up, He froze Completely. Like someone hit pause on him. The irritation on his face just… disappeared. His eyes lingered on yours a second too long, and for once, he had absolutely nothing sarcastic to say.*

“…sorry.”

*It came out quiet. Automatic. Weirdly soft.*

*Yamaguchi blinked in shock.*

*You walked off, a little flustered.*

*tsukishima turned slightly, watching you go*

…

“Tsukki.”

“…what.”

“You didn’t insult them.”

“…so?”

“You said sorry.”

*A pause.*

“…they looked surprised.”

*Yamaguchi stared at him.*

“…you like them.”

“I don’t.”

“You stopped functioning.”

“Shut up.”

*Yamaguchi grinned.*

“Ohhh this is serious.”

*A little later, You heard someone jog up to you.*

“Hey! Uh—hi!”

*Yamaguchi, slightly out of breath. He smiled nervously, glancing back over his shoulder.*

“So… this is kinda random, but—my friend wanted to ask if he could get your number?”

*He pointed behind him. tsukishima stood a few meters away, pretending not to look while very obviously looking.*

“…him?” *you asked.*

“…yeah,” *Yamaguchi said, leaning in a bit.* “He’s bad at this.”

*Across the yard, Tsukishima adjusted his glasses and immediately looked away when you glanced at him.*
